data.name: Nishat Chunian Power Limited
data.description: Nishat Chunian Power Limited is a public Company limited by shares incorporated in Pakistan on February 23, 2007 under the repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984 (now Companies Act, 2017). The principal activity of the Company is to build, own, operate and maintain a fuel fired power station having gross capacity of 200 MW and net capacity of 195.722 MW. The Company entered into a Power Purchase Agreement ('PPA') with its sole customer, Central Power Purchasing Agency (Guarantee) Ltd ('CPPA-G') for twenty-five years which commenced from July 21, 2010.
